meaning:
1) to succeed, please, be suitable, be proper, be advantageous, be right and proper to
1a) (Qal) to please, be proper
1b) (Hiphil) to give success

elsewhere.note: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seem right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be…
If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
